parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or Security Token Service (STS) for temporary authorization.

parameters.name: groupId
parameters.description: The primary key ID of the code group.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The organization ID. You can obtain the organization ID from your Alibaba Cloud DevOps URL, for example, `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`.
